groups.name: Play
groups.profile: Play (PlayCrypt), active since mid-2022; closed group with intermittent encryption, exploits of FortiOS and Exchange, and data posted after deadlines. Today a batch of five posted 19:18 UTC (RansomLook) / 19:45–19:48 UTC (Ransomware.live).
groups.sectors: Manufacturing, Retail & E-Commerce, Sector not disclosed, Technology

groups.name: Inc Ransom
groups.profile: INC Ransom, active since mid-2023; spear-phishing and exploitation of Citrix/FortiGate edge devices; heavy US healthcare and professional-services focus. Two of today’s four are bare domain listings (“full data client/corp”).
groups.sectors: Financial Services, Professional Services, Sector not disclosed

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: SilentRansomGroup (aka Luna Moth / Chatty Spider): data-extortion crew without encryption, subject of a May 2025 FBI warning for callback-phishing and helpdesk vishing against US law firms. RansomLook tracks its site as “leakeddata”. Today: four named law-firm-style victims plus six masked “FULL DATA TIMER” teasers (excluded).

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Posts descriptive, often unnamed targets with publication deadlines and itemised record lists.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS (aka Agenda) since 2022; Rust/Go lockers, VMware ESXi targeting, double extortion; among the most active groups of 2025–26. Today includes a US public university.

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Newer leak site posting long, sector-tagged write-ups with redacted item lists; seen daily in recent issues.

groups.name: Falcon
groups.profile: RedPacket Security has noted its claims are unverified.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: Aoqin / Aoqin Leaks: little-documented leak site focused on US mid-market firms; feeds use different names, merged here.

groups.name: Black X
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; today’s only listing claims full customer card data from a Spanish hotel chain, without a sample in the feed.

groups.name: Eclipse
groups.profile: Small leak site seen in recent issues, posting firms with long company profiles.

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: Long-running RaaS (since 2019) relying on exposed RDP and phishing.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (CISA advisory AA23-319A); hits healthcare, education, government and legal; publishes large file inventories, as with today’s dental-practice PHI dump.

groups.name: SafePay
groups.profile: Active since late 2024, no affiliate program; known for fast VPN/RDP intrusions with stolen credentials.

groups.name: Scarlettgroup
groups.profile: Emerging data-extortion crew first seen Oct 2026, hospital-heavy.
